#stimulate data
```{r}
#STEP0. load seed gene and gene list 40000 of GSE11923
load("~/scRhythmBayes/data/GSE11923_gene_list_4000random.RData")
load("~/scRhythmBayes/data/merge_27seedgenes_bmal1.Rdata")
gene_4000
seed27_in

#STEP1. meta: symbol-level ZT + cell-level ground truth time
#ZT
ZT_points <- c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20)
n_time <- length(ZT_points)

#cell
cells_per_time <- 20000
N <- n_time * cells_per_time

#celltype
celltypes <- 1:4
cells_per_ct_per_time <- cells_per_time / length(celltypes)  # 5000
stopifnot(cells_per_ct_per_time == floor(cells_per_ct_per_time))  

#0-24h
wrap24 <- function(x) ((x %% 24) + 24) %% 24


# Normal jitter around each ZT for ground truth (hours)
sigma_t <- 0.8

meta_list <- vector("list", n_time)

for (k in seq_along(ZT_points)) {
  zt <- ZT_points[k]

  # 400 cells
  ct_vec <- rep(celltypes, each = cells_per_ct_per_time)
  n_k <- length(ct_vec)

  t_true <- rnorm(n_k, mean = zt, sd = sigma_t)
  t_true <- wrap24(t_true)

  cell_id <- paste0("ZT", zt, "_cell", sprintf("%03d", seq_len(n_k)))

  meta_list[[k]] <- tibble(
    cell_id  = cell_id,
    ZT_sym   = zt,
    t_true   = t_true,
    theta_rad = 2*pi*t_true/24,
    celltype = ct_vec
  )
}

meta <- bind_rows(meta_list) %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(meta) <- meta$cell_id
stopifnot(nrow(meta) == N)

#STEP2. library sizes
lib_mean <- 5000
lib_sd_log10 <- 0.5

lib_size <- round(10^(rnorm(N, mean = log10(lib_mean), sd = lib_sd_log10)))
lib_size <- pmax(200L, as.integer(lib_size))  # clamp to avoid tiny libs

meta$lib_size <- lib_size
stopifnot(all(meta$lib_size > 0))


#STEP3. truth parameters per gene x celltype: b, A, phi
genes <- as.character(gene_4000)
G <- length(genes)
C <- length(celltypes)

seed_mask <- genes %in% seed27_in
seed_idx <- which(seed_mask)
nonseed_idx <- which(!seed_mask)

# 3.1 baseline b_{g,c} 
b_base <- rlnorm(G, meanlog = log(0.02), sdlog = 0.8) 
b_mat  <- matrix(rep(b_base, C), nrow = G, ncol = C)

ct_drift <- c(0.10, 0.25, 0.75, 1.00) 
b_mat <- sweep(b_mat, 2, ct_drift, "*")

# 3.2 celltype markers
set.seed(2026)
marker_per_ct <- 120
marker_pool_idx <- nonseed_idx

marker_idx_list <- lapply(celltypes, function(ct){
  sample(marker_pool_idx, size = min(marker_per_ct, length(marker_pool_idx)), replace = FALSE)
})

for (ct in celltypes) {
  midx <- marker_idx_list[[ct]]
  b_mat[midx, ct] <- b_mat[midx, ct] * 8   # marker boost
}

# 3.3 phase phi_{g,c} in hours [0,24) 
wrap24 <- function(x) ((x %% 24) + 24) %% 24


phi_base <- runif(G, min = 0, max = 24)
phi_mat  <- matrix(rep(phi_base, C), nrow = G, ncol = C)

ct_shift <- c(0, 0.5, 1.5, 2)  # 小时；CT之间相位轻微偏移
phi_mat <- sweep(phi_mat, 2, ct_shift, "+")
phi_mat <- wrap24(phi_mat)

# 3.4 amplitude A_{g,c} 
set.seed(2027)
A_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = G, ncol = C)

p_cycler_ct1_4 <- 0.45

# non-seed rhythmic indicator
R_nonseed <- matrix(0L, nrow = length(nonseed_idx), ncol = C)
R_nonseed[, 1] <- rbinom(length(nonseed_idx), 1, p_cycler_ct1_4)
R_nonseed[, 2] <- rbinom(length(nonseed_idx), 1, p_cycler_ct1_4)
R_nonseed[, 3] <- rbinom(length(nonseed_idx), 1, p_cycler_ct1_4)
R_nonseed[, 4] <- rbinom(length(nonseed_idx), 1, p_cycler_ct1_4)

# draw amplitudes 
A_draw_nonseed <- rgamma(length(nonseed_idx) * C, shape = 2.0, rate = 20)  # mean~0.1
A_draw_nonseed <- matrix(A_draw_nonseed, nrow = length(nonseed_idx), ncol = C)
A_nonseed <- A_draw_nonseed * R_nonseed
A_mat[nonseed_idx, ] <- A_nonseed

# seed amplitudes: always rhythmic
A_draw_seed <- rgamma(length(seed_idx) * C, shape = 2.2, rate = 18)  
A_draw_seed <- matrix(A_draw_seed, nrow = length(seed_idx), ncol = C)
A_mat[seed_idx, ] <- A_draw_seed


A_mat <- pmin(A_mat, 1.0)


truth_params <- list(
  genes = genes,
  celltypes = celltypes,
  b_mat = b_mat,
  A_mat = A_mat,
  phi_mat = phi_mat,
  seed27_in = seed27_in,
  marker_idx_list = marker_idx_list
)


# STEP4. generate counts by celltype blocks: (t_true, celltype)->proportion->Poisson->dropout
omega <- 2*pi/24

# dropout
eta0 <- 1.2
eta1 <- -1.1
eps0 <- 1e-8


counts_dense <- matrix(0L, nrow = G, ncol = N)
rownames(counts_dense) <- genes
colnames(counts_dense) <- meta$cell_id

for (ct in celltypes) {

  cell_idx <- which(meta$celltype == ct)
  t_vec <- meta$t_true[cell_idx]
  L_vec <- meta$lib_size[cell_idx]

  b_vec  <- b_mat[, ct]
  A_vec  <- A_mat[, ct]
  ph_vec <- phi_mat[, ct]

  # diff_mat[g,i] = t_i - phi_g
  diff_mat <- outer(ph_vec, t_vec, FUN = function(p, t) t - p)
  diff_mat <- matrix(diff_mat, nrow = G)
  
  mu_mat <- b_vec + A_vec * cos(omega * diff_mat)
  mu_mat <- pmax(0, mu_mat)
  mu_mat <- matrix(mu_mat, nrow = G)
  
  col_sum <- colSums(mu_mat)
  col_sum <- pmax(col_sum, eps0)

  p_mat <- sweep(mu_mat, 2, col_sum, "/")
  lambda_mat <- sweep(p_mat, 2, L_vec, "*")

  # Poisson sampling
  y_vec <- rpois(length(lambda_mat), lambda = as.numeric(lambda_mat))
  y_mat <- matrix(y_vec, nrow = G, ncol = length(cell_idx))

  # Dropout probability depends on log(lambda)
  dprob_mat <- plogis(eta0 + eta1 * log(lambda_mat + eps0))
  drop_mask <- matrix(runif(length(dprob_mat)) < as.numeric(dprob_mat),
                      nrow = G, ncol = length(cell_idx))
  y_mat[drop_mask] <- 0L

  counts_dense[, cell_idx] <- y_mat

  rm(diff_mat, mu_mat, p_mat, lambda_mat, y_vec, y_mat, dprob_mat, drop_mask)
  gc()

  message("Done celltype ", ct, " | cells = ", length(cell_idx))
}

counts_sparse <- Matrix(counts_dense, sparse = TRUE)


# STEP5. save outputs
out_dir <- "~/scRhythmBayes/data"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(counts_sparse, file = file.path(out_dir, "sim_counts.rds"))
data.table::fwrite(meta, file = file.path(out_dir, "sim_meta_new.csv"))
saveRDS(truth_params, file = file.path(out_dir, "sim_truth_params_new.rds"))


str(truth_params, max.level = 1)
colMeans(truth_params$A_mat > 0)

seed_mask <- truth_params$genes %in% seed27_in
colMeans(truth_params$A_mat[!seed_mask, , drop = FALSE] > 0)
colMeans(truth_params$A_mat[seed_mask, ])

#seurat
sim_counts_dgCMatrix <- readRDS("~/scRhythmBayes/data/sim_counts.rds")
sim_meta <- read_csv("~/scRhythmBayes/data/sim_meta_new.csv")

sim_meta <- as.data.frame(sim_meta)
rownames(sim_meta) <- sim_meta$cell_id

stopifnot(identical(colnames(sim_counts_dgCMatrix), rownames(sim_meta)))
sum(is.na(rownames(sim_counts_dgCMatrix)))
valid_genes <- !is.na(rownames(sim_counts_dgCMatrix))


sim_counts_dgCMatrix <- sim_counts_dgCMatrix[valid_genes, ]
sim_meta <- sim_meta 

stopifnot(!any(is.na(rownames(sim_counts_dgCMatrix))))

obj_sim <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = sim_counts_dgCMatrix,
  meta.data = sim_meta,
  project = "simulate data"
)
save(obj_sim,file = "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/simulate_data_new2.Rdata")
saveRDS(obj_sim,file = "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/simulate_data_new2.rds")

rm(gene_4000,seed27_in,ZT_points,n_time,cells_per_time,N,celltypes,cells_per_ct_per_time,wrap24,sigma_t,meta_list,k,zt,ct_vec,n_k,t_true,cell_id,lib_mean,lib_sd_log10,lib_size,genes,G,C,seed_mask,seed_idx,nonseed_idx,b_base,b_mat,ct_drift,marker_per_ct,marker_pool_idx,marker_idx_list,ct,midx,phi_base,phi_mat,ct_shift,p_cycler_ct1_4,R_nonseed,A_draw_nonseed,A_nonseed,A_draw_seed,A_mat,truth_params,omega,eta0,eta1,eps0,counts_dense,cell_idx,t_vec,L_vec,b_vec,A_vec,ph_vec,col_sum,out_dir,sim_counts_dgCMatrix,sim_meta,valid_genes);gc()

rm(counts_sparse,meta);gc()
```
